title: 第11章 美猴王第12章 五年
content_zh:
天庭。
哪吒目光扫过殿上众仙，问道：
“在场诸位，应该没有谁是后天生灵吧？”
听到哪吒的话。
在场所有仙官，都不自觉点头。
那是当然！
能成仙者，又岂会是后天生灵？
“先天生灵”
资质，才是成仙的基础！
至于后天生灵？
能够修到“炼神返虚”
，成为下界一方顶尖修士，已是极限！
除非对方愿意舍去肉体，修成类似于“城隍”
般的香火神灵。
否则，后天生灵几乎不可能成仙！
哪吒看向上方玉帝：
“陛下乃是三界之主。”
“这三界众生，皆归陛下统御！”
“哪吒认为，既然天道让这孩童诞生，便有其道理。”
玉帝眼中露出满意神色。

哪吒这话，确实是说到他心里去了。
是啊！
自己是三界之主。
难道连一个后天生灵都容不下吗？
其实，玉帝本来也没把这事太放心上。
只不过。
那天地奇石碎裂时的动静太大。
三界已经很久没有发生过这种大动静了。
所以，玉帝才会注意到这件事。
如今，哪吒也已经说了。
那天地奇石中孕育的孩童，只是一个后天生灵。
自然也就不必理会了！
无论是玉帝还是一众仙官，都下意识地忽略了那个石猴。
毕竟，在众人看来。
一只猴罢了？
还能反了天不成？
众所周知。
这世间万物，无论是何根脚。
其最终显化的肉身，都是人族模样。
content_en:
Heaven.
Nezha glanced at the immortals in the hall and asked:
"There shouldn't be any of you here who are born after birth, right?"
Hear what Nezha said.
All the immortal officials present nodded unconsciously.
Of course!
How can a person who can become an immortal become an acquired being?
"Innate Creature"
Qualification is the foundation for becoming an immortal!
As for acquired creatures?
Able to cultivate to the point of "Refining the God and Returning to the Void"
, becoming the top monk in the lower realm is already the limit!
Unless the other party is willing to give up his body and become something like a "City God"
Like the incense god.
Otherwise, it is almost impossible for an acquired soul to become an immortal!
Nezha looked at the Jade Emperor above:
"Your Majesty is the Lord of the Three Realms."
"All living beings in these three realms are under the control of Your Majesty!"
"Nezha believes that since God allowed this child to be born, it makes sense."
There was a look of satisfaction in the Jade Emperor's eyes.
Nezha's words indeed spoke to his heart.
yes!
He is the Lord of the Three Realms.
Isn't there even room for an acquired soul?
In fact, the Jade Emperor didn't take this matter too seriously.
only.
There was too much movement when the strange rocks on earth shattered.
There hasn't been such a big movement in the Three Realms for a long time.
That's why the Jade Emperor noticed this.
Now, Nezha has also said it.
The child conceived in the strange rocks of heaven and earth is just an acquired creature.
Naturally, there is no need to pay attention to it!
Both the Jade Emperor and the immortal officials subconsciously ignored the stone monkey.
After all, in the eyes of everyone.
Just a monkey?
How could he go against the grain?
As everyone knows.
All things in this world, no matter what their roots are.
The physical bodies they finally manifested were all humanoid.
